title: Why CleanSpark Stock Climbed Today
author: Joe Tenebruso
description: CleanSpark shares jumped 9.22% after signing a transformational 20-year lease deal with a major tech company for its Georgia data center campus, projected to generate $6.6 billion in contracted revenue (up to $11.6 billion with extensions). The company is strategically shifting from Bitcoin mining to AI data center infrastructure, which offers more predictable and profitable revenue streams.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock climbed 9.22% on a major multibillion-dollar lease deal with a leading tech company. The 20-year contract provides substantial contracted revenue ($6.6-11.6 billion) and validates the company's strategic pivot from Bitcoin mining to more profitable and predictable AI data center infrastructure.

title: Stock Market Today, July 14: Growth Stocks Rally as Inflation Cools to 3.5%, Equaling 2020 Lows
author: Josh Kohn-Lindquist
description: U.S. stock markets rallied on July 14, 2026, as inflation cooled to 3.5%, matching 2020 lows and boosting growth stocks. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.06%, while the S&P 500 gained 0.49%. IBM plunged 24% on earnings concerns, while CleanSpark and Tower Semiconductor surged on major infrastructure and expansion announcements. Banking stocks showed mixed results as earnings season began.

title: Stock Market Today, June 26: Keel Infrastructure Rises as Convertible Financing Backs AI Data Center Push
author: Eric Trie
description: Keel Infrastructure rose 2.47% to $6.01 following a $458 million convertible-note financing to fund AI data-center expansion. The company, rebranded from Bitfarms, faces the challenge of converting power-secured sites into signed customer leases to demonstrate clear project economics. Peers CleanSpark and Riot Platforms also gained ground in the digital infrastructure sector.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the stock rose on financing news, the article emphasizes execution risks. The $458M convertible provides financial flexibility, but long-term value depends on converting power-secured sites into signed leases and demonstrating viable project economics, which remains uncertain.
Stock gained 2.90% alongside sector strength in digital infrastructure for AI/HPC workloads, indicating positive investor sentiment in the competitive landscape.

title: Canaan vs. CleanSpark: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
author: Pamela Kock
description: The article compares two Bitcoin mining industry players: Canaan, a hardware manufacturer for mining equipment, and CleanSpark, a data center operator. While both companies showed strong revenue growth in FY 2025 (96.7% and 102.2% respectively), CleanSpark achieved profitability with a 47.6% net margin, whereas Canaan reported a significant net loss. The author recommends CleanSpark despite acknowledging both companies face crypto market volatility and intense competition.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company shows strong revenue growth (96.7% YoY) and low debt-to-equity ratio (0.1x), but reported a significant net loss of $210.3M with negative 39.7% net margin. While described as 'more interesting' for its picks-and-shovels business model and innovation potential, the author ultimately did not select it as the better buy.

title: Olenox (OLOX) Stock Surges Over 61% After Hours: Here's What You Should Know
author: Mohd Haider
description: Olenox Industries announced the closing of its $30 million acquisition of CS Digital Ventures, combining natural gas assets and data center infrastructure. The deal includes $14 million in Series D Preferred Stock and a $16 million promissory note. CS Digital brings 35 MW of installed capacity and $20.6 million in 2025 revenue. The combined platform targets power costs below $0.02 per kWh for off-grid data centers. OLOX shares surged 61.79% in after-hours trading.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock surged 61.79% after-hours following successful acquisition closing. The deal creates a platform with competitive power costs ($0.02/kWh) targeting energy-intensive compute customers, positioning the company favorably in the AI infrastructure market.
